detail.title: Walk-through Metal Detector
detail.overview: Favourite ISC-D718S-I Walk-through Metal Detector Key Points ●Information Release ●People Recognize ●Dual 29.1-Inch Color Screen With Downward-Angle Design ●Storage Management ●Multi-Digit Password Protection Sales Enquiry Datasheet

System.Display: Front and rear 29-inch LCD screens (1,920 x 540)

General.Packaging Dimensions: H × W × D: Packing Box (Detector panel): 2,562 mm × 768 mm × 267 mm (100.87" × 30.24" × 10.51") Packing Box (Host box): 869 mm × 564 mm × 515 mm (34.21" × 22.20" × 20.28")

Personnel Intelligence.Intelligent Playback (Face Detection): 1. Query conditions: Search pictures by pass channel, time and personnel attributes. 2. Function: Supports the query results to associate playback of 10-second videos before and after the event, and supports export of search results to excel, videos, and pictures. 3. Historical library capacity: 10 million
Personnel Intelligence.Personnel Database Management: 1. Import method: single/batch import of the personnel pictures through the browser, the single import speed is 10 pic/sec. 2. Input personnel information: name, gender, birthday, province, city, certificate type, and certificate number. 3. Database capacity: Up to 10 personnel databases with 300,000 pictures can be created, and the total capacity is 50 G. 4. Image requirements: jpg format, maximum 4M for a single image, pixel 100 × 100–6,000 × 5,000.
Personnel Intelligence.Personnel Comparison: Supports deployment of multiple personnel databases, alarm prompts, video linkage , capture, IPC external alarm output, voice prompt, buzzer, log and mail. Performance: The AI by device function supports 1-channel personnel comparison (1080p video stream).

Recording Management.Recording Method: Auto recording; manual recording; alarm recording; scheduled recording
Recording Management.Playback Method: Instant playback; conventional playback; event playback; label playback; Intelligent playback (personnel, dynamic detection)
Recording Management.Video Compression: Smart H.265; H.265; Smart H.264; H.264

Alarm.Anomaly Alarm: Supports the alarms for IPC disconnection, storage error, full storage, IP conflict, MAC conflict and login lock.
Alarm.Intelligent Alarm: Supports personnel detection, personnel comparison and IVS (tripwire and area intrusion).
Alarm.Alarm Linkage: Video, capture, IPC external alarm output, voice prompt, buzzer, log record, preset point and mail.

Network.Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; Ipv4; RTSP; UDP; SMTP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; P2P; IPv6

Information Release.Information Release: Supports the instant release of pictures, text, rich text, and video information.
Information Release.Play Mode: Supports insertion, designated time period and periodic play.
Information Release.Play Time Customization: Play time can be customized, and the play plan can be set by day or week.

Accessories.Others: No hard disk is shipped by default. Optional (3.5"SATA interface) The host and its supporting detector panels need to be ordered separately.
